name: Saceda-Trasierra (Spain)
description: White field within a border of green and black triangles, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Saceda-Trasierra (a willow between a cross of Saint James and a chequy field).
history: Municipal flag of Saceda-Trasierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: border of alternating green and black triangles
Saceda-Trasierra arms — willow, cross of Saint James and chequy
